ja: 先週 Docker は入れたんだけど、ボリュームの共有方法はまだわかってないんだ。
en: I set up Docker last week, but I still haven't figured out how to share volumes.
alternatives: I installed Docker last week, but I still haven't worked out how to share volumes.
I got Docker set up last week, but I haven't figured out how to share volumes yet.
point: last week は過去形、「まだ〜ない」は現在完了で

ja: チームに展開する前に、リンターをどう設定したか順を追って説明してもらえますか？
en: Could you walk me through how you set up the linter before we roll it out to the team?
alternatives: Before we roll it out to the team, could you walk me through how you configured the linter?
Could you take me through how you set up the linter before we roll it out to the whole team?
point: walk me through ＋ how 節は疑問文の語順にしない

ja: 僕のマシンでビルドが通らなかった原因は、設定ファイルじゃなくて古い Node のバージョンだったんだ。
en: It was the outdated Node version, not the config file, that broke the build on my machine.
alternatives: What broke the build on my machine was the outdated Node version, not the config file.
It wasn't the config file but the old Node version that broke the build on my machine.
point: It was A, not B, that 〜 で原因を強調する
